name: Counter Strike 1.6
author: admin@baroy.net
description:
Counter-Strike 1.6 with ReHLDS binaries egg.

ReHLDS is a reverse-engineered, optimized version of HLDS.
Developed by third-party modders to improve stability, performance, and security.
Fully compatible with MetaMod, AMX Mod X, and other plugins.

installation.script:
#!bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

SERVER_DIR="${SERVER_DIR:-/mnt/server}"
STEAMCMD_DIR="$SERVER_DIR/steamcmd"
STEAM_USER="${STEAM_USER:-anonymous}"
STEAM_PASS="${STEAM_PASS:-}"
STEAM_AUTH="${STEAM_AUTH:-}"
HLDS_GAME="${HLDS_GAME:-cstrike}"
HLDS_BRANCH="${HLDS_BRANCH:-}"
SRCDS_BETAPASS="${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}"
INSTALL_FLAGS="${INSTALL_FLAGS:-}"
INSTALL_MODULES="${INSTALL_MODULES:-rehlds,amxmodx,metamod-r,regamedll_cs,reapi,reunion}"
SERVER_CFG_URL="${SERVER_CFG_URL:-https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hardixnph/configs/refs/heads/main/server.cfg}"

if [[ -z "${HLDS_APPID:-}" ]]; then
    echo "HLDS_APPID is required." >&2
    exit 1
fi

for command in curl jq tar unzip; do
    if ! command -v "$command" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "Required command not found: $command" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if [[ "$STEAM_USER" == "anonymous" ]]; then
    echo -e "Steam user is not set.\nUsing anonymous user."
else
    echo "Steam user is set."
fi

mkdir -p "$STEAMCMD_DIR" "$SERVER_DIR/steamapps" "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME"
curl -fsSL -o /tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz -C "$STEAMCMD_DIR"
rm -f /tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz

export HOME="$SERVER_DIR"
cd "$STEAMCMD_DIR"

STEAMCMD_ARGS=(+force_install_dir "$SERVER_DIR" +login "$STEAM_USER")
if [[ "$STEAM_USER" != "anonymous" ]]; then
    STEAMCMD_ARGS+=("$STEAM_PASS")
    [[ -z "$STEAM_AUTH" ]] || STEAMCMD_ARGS+=("$STEAM_AUTH")
fi
STEAMCMD_ARGS+=(+app_set_config 90 mod "$HLDS_GAME")
STEAMCMD_ARGS+=(+app_update "$HLDS_APPID")
[[ -z "$HLDS_BRANCH" ]] || STEAMCMD_ARGS+=(-beta "$HLDS_BRANCH")
[[ -z "$SRCDS_BETAPASS" ]] || STEAMCMD_ARGS+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
if [[ -n "$INSTALL_FLAGS" ]]; then
    read -r -a INSTALL_FLAGS_ARRAY <<< "$INSTALL_FLAGS"
    STEAMCMD_ARGS+=("${INSTALL_FLAGS_ARRAY[@]}")
fi
STEAMCMD_ARGS+=(+quit)
./steamcmd.sh "${STEAMCMD_ARGS[@]}"

mkdir -p "$SERVER_DIR/.steam/sdk32" "$SERVER_DIR/.steam/sdk64"
[[ ! -f linux32/steamclient.so ]] || cp -f linux32/steamclient.so "$SERVER_DIR/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so"
[[ ! -f linux64/steamclient.so ]] || cp -f linux64/steamclient.so "$SERVER_DIR/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so"

STAGING_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$STAGING_DIR"' EXIT

release_asset_url() {
    local repository="$1"
    local asset_regex="$2"
    local release_json
    release_json="$(curl -fsSL "https://api.github.com/repos/$repository/releases/latest")"
    jq -er --arg regex "$asset_regex" \
        '[.assets[] | select(.name | test($regex; "i"))][0].browser_download_url // empty' \
        <<< "$release_json"
}

download_release_asset() {
    local repository="$1"
    local asset_regex="$2"
    local destination="$3"
    local url

    if ! url="$(release_asset_url "$repository" "$asset_regex")"; then
        echo "No matching release asset found for $repository ($asset_regex)." >&2
        return 1
    fi

    echo "Downloading latest $repository release asset..."
    curl -fL --retry 3 -o "$destination" "$url"
}

extract_archive() {
    local archive="$1"
    local destination="$2"
    mkdir -p "$destination"
    case "$archive" in
        *.tar.gz) tar -xzf "$archive" -C "$destination" ;;
        *.zip) unzip -qo "$archive" -d "$destination" ;;
        *) echo "Unsupported archive format: $archive" >&2; return 1 ;;
    esac
}

install_rehlds() {
    local archive="$STAGING_DIR/rehlds.zip"
    local extracted="$STAGING_DIR/rehlds"
    download_release_asset "rehlds/ReHLDS" '^rehlds-bin-[^/]+\.zip$' "$archive"
    mkdir -p "$extracted"
    unzip -q "$archive" -d "$extracted"
    [[ -d "$extracted/bin/linux32" ]] || { echo "ReHLDS Linux binaries are missing." >&2; return 1; }
    cp -a "$extracted/bin/linux32/." "$SERVER_DIR/"
}

install_amxmodx() {
    local base_archive="$STAGING_DIR/amxmodx-base.tar.gz"
    local cstrike_archive="$STAGING_DIR/amxmodx-cstrike.tar.gz"
    download_release_asset "alliedmodders/amxmodx" '^amxmodx-.*-base-linux\.tar\.gz$' "$base_archive"
    download_release_asset "alliedmodders/amxmodx" '^amxmodx-.*-cstrike-linux\.tar\.gz$' "$cstrike_archive"
    extract_archive "$base_archive" "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME"
    extract_archive "$cstrike_archive" "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME"
}

install_metamod() {
    local archive="$STAGING_DIR/metamod.zip"
    local extracted="$STAGING_DIR/metamod"
    download_release_asset "rehlds/metamod-r" '^metamod-bin-[^/]+\.zip$' "$archive"
    mkdir -p "$extracted"
    unzip -q "$archive" -d "$extracted"
    [[ -d "$extracted/addons/metamod" ]] || { echo "Metamod-R files are missing." >&2; return 1; }
    mkdir -p "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME/addons"
    cp -a "$extracted/addons/metamod" "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME/addons/"
}

install_regamedll() {
    local archive="$STAGING_DIR/regamedll.zip"
    local extracted="$STAGING_DIR/regamedll"
    download_release_asset "rehlds/ReGameDLL_CS" '^regamedll-bin-[^/]+\.zip$' "$archive"
    mkdir -p "$extracted"
    unzip -q "$archive" -d "$extracted"
    [[ -d "$extracted/bin/linux32/cstrike" ]] || { echo "ReGameDLL_CS Linux files are missing." >&2; return 1; }
    cp -a "$extracted/bin/linux32/cstrike/." "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME/"
}

install_reapi() {
    local archive="$STAGING_DIR/reapi.zip"
    download_release_asset "rehlds/ReAPI" '^reapi-bin-[^/]+\.zip$' "$archive"
    unzip -qo "$archive" -d "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME"
}

install_reunion() {
    local archive="$STAGING_DIR/reunion.zip"
    local extracted="$STAGING_DIR/reunion"
    local destination="$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME/addons/metamod/reunion"
    download_release_asset "rehlds/reunion" '^reunion-[^/]+\.zip$' "$archive"
    mkdir -p "$extracted"
    unzip -q "$archive" -d "$extracted"
    local binary="bin/Linux/reunion_mm_i386.so"
    [[ -f "$extracted/$binary" ]] || { echo "ReUnion Linux binary is missing." >&2; return 1; }
    mkdir -p "$destination"
    cp -f "$extracted/$binary" "$destination/"

    if [[ ! -f "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME/reunion.cfg" ]]; then
        cp -f "$extracted/reunion.cfg" "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME/reunion.cfg"
        local salt
        salt="$(tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9' </dev/urandom | head -c 50 || true)"
        if [[ -n "$salt" ]]; then
            sed -i "s/^SteamIdHashSalt[[:space:]]*=.*/SteamIdHashSalt = $salt/" "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME/reunion.cfg"
        fi
    fi
}

INSTALLED_METAMOD=0
INSTALLED_AMXMODX=0
INSTALLED_REUNION=0
IFS=',' read -r -a MODULE_LIST <<< "$INSTALL_MODULES"
for raw_module in "${MODULE_LIST[@]}"; do
    module="$(printf '%s' "$raw_module" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr -d '[:space:]')"
    case "$module" in
        rehlds)
            install_rehlds
            ;;
        amxmodx)
            install_amxmodx
            INSTALLED_AMXMODX=1
            ;;
        metamod|metamod-r)
            install_metamod
            INSTALLED_METAMOD=1
            ;;
        regamedll|regamedll_cs)
            install_regamedll
            ;;
        reapi)
            install_reapi
            ;;
        reunion)
            install_reunion
            INSTALLED_REUNION=1
            ;;
        "")
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Unknown module in INSTALL_MODULES: $raw_module" >&2
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

if [[ "$INSTALLED_METAMOD" == "1" ]]; then
    GAME_DIR="$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME"
    METAMOD_PLUGINS="$GAME_DIR/addons/metamod/plugins.ini"
    mkdir -p "$GAME_DIR/addons/metamod"
    touch "$METAMOD_PLUGINS"

    if [[ "$INSTALLED_AMXMODX" == "1" ]]; then
        AMXX_LINE='linux addons/amxmodx/dlls/amxmodx_mm_i386.so'
        grep -qxF "$AMXX_LINE" "$METAMOD_PLUGINS" || printf '%s\n' "$AMXX_LINE" >> "$METAMOD_PLUGINS"
    fi
    if [[ "$INSTALLED_REUNION" == "1" ]]; then
        REUNION_LINE='linux addons/metamod/reunion/reunion_mm_i386.so'
        grep -qxF "$REUNION_LINE" "$METAMOD_PLUGINS" || printf '%s\n' "$REUNION_LINE" >> "$METAMOD_PLUGINS"
    fi

    LIBLIST="$GAME_DIR/liblist.gam"
    if [[ -f "$LIBLIST" ]]; then
        if grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*gamedll_linux([[:space:]]|$)' "$LIBLIST"; then
            sed -i 's|^[[:space:]]*gamedll_linux.*|gamedll_linux "addons/metamod/metamod_i386.so"|' "$LIBLIST"
        else
            printf '\ngamedll_linux "addons/metamod/metamod_i386.so"\n' >> "$LIBLIST"
        fi
    fi
fi

if [[ "$INSTALLED_AMXMODX" == "1" && "$INSTALLED_METAMOD" != "1" ]]; then
    echo "Warning: AMX Mod X is installed but will not load without Metamod-R." >&2
fi
if [[ "$INSTALLED_REUNION" == "1" && "$INSTALLED_METAMOD" != "1" ]]; then
    echo "Warning: ReUnion is installed but will not load without Metamod-R." >&2
fi

mkdir -p "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME/addons/amxmodx/data"
[[ -f "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME/listip.cfg" ]] || printf '// Banned IPs\n' > "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME/listip.cfg"
[[ -f "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME/banned.cfg" ]] || printf '// Banned IDs\n' > "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME/banned.cfg"
[[ -f "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME/addons/amxmodx/data/csstats.dat" ]] || touch "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME/addons/amxmodx/data/csstats.dat"

echo "Downloading server.cfg..."
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$STAGING_DIR/server.cfg" "$SERVER_CFG_URL"
[[ -s "$STAGING_DIR/server.cfg" ]] || { echo "Downloaded server.cfg is empty." >&2; exit 1; }
cp -f "$STAGING_DIR/server.cfg" "$SERVER_DIR/$HLDS_GAME/server.cfg"

chmod -R 777 /mnt/server

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation Complete!"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

The HLDS server ID is 90. This should not be changed.

variables.description: Leave empty for the public branch, for the legacy version select steam_legacy.
